name: altered level of consciousness overview
title: Altered level of consciousness: treat the reversible causes first, then the exam (brainstem reflexes, breathing, motor response, eye opening and signs of awareness) places the patient as brain death, coma, vegetative state, minimally conscious state minus or plus, or a locked-in coma mimic

root.title: Not responding: FIRST look for the TREATABLE causes
lines: shock or low blood pressure · low glucose · diabetic ketoacidosis · hypertensive encephalopathy · drug intoxication
bacterial or fungal meningitis · herpes simplex encephalitis · brain abscess · epidural or subdural hematoma
then EXAMINE: is the patient AWAKE (alertness) and AWARE (awareness)?

groups.title: NOT aware
lines: brainstem reflexes and eye opening decide

head: h
Brain death
Canadian criteria: ALL of
awake: • known cause that can cause it
exam: • deep coma, no motor response (spinal reflexes allowed)
• NO pupil (mid-size or larger), corneal, vestibulo-ocular, gag, cough

head: h
Coma
both hemispheres, both thalami, or brainstem above the mid-pons
exam: • decorticate: arms FLEX, legs extend → above the red nucleus
• decerebrate: all EXTEND → below the red nucleus

head: h
Vegetative state
aka UNRESPONSIVE WAKEFULNESS syndrome
exam: • grimace, yawn, roving eyes, flexion withdrawal

head: h
Locked-in syndrome
NOT a disorder of consciousness
eeg: other mimics: Guillain-Barré, myasthenia, neuromuscular blockade, akinetic mutism, psychogenic
